observations: What the architect asked to be proven about the siblings, measured one by one. The TypeScript constant (90_000), the daemon's Heartbeat (90 s), notice_exceptions.go's pluginHeartbeat (90 s), the two Go comments in packages/envoy/internal/session/claim.go and packages/envoy/cmd/listener/delivery.go (90 seconds, three missed heartbeats - arithmetically right, 300 s / 90 s = 3.33) and the smoke script (which now reads both numbers from the tree and refuses by name when it cannot) all agree today. The build check catches a lone move of the TypeScript constant, of the registry ttl, of the daemon's Heartbeat and of the daemon's window - each proven above. It does not catch a lone move of pluginHeartbeat: with it set back to 2 * time.Minute and nothing else touched, the check exits 0. That constant is not a comment - it is noticeReholdDelays[1], the delay before the second re-hold copy - so one of the four copies of this invariant is unguarded by the check the issue adds. CI caught this one through the daemon's own test (the failure above), which is the current guard.

The two red checks the architect named were confirmed by reading rather than inherited. Worker Image run 40165263665: the only failing step of the `build` job is `docker/setup-buildx-action`, before any file of this branch is read, and `repos/sjawhar/legion/rules/branches/main` requires lint, typecheck, test and pr-title alone, so it is not a required check. The Tests run's failure is a different matter and is recorded in `failures`: it is the Go daemon suite, which this branch does change.

What was left behind. Every pane ran in a fresh /tmp scratch directory with --no-skills --no-rules --no-extensions --no-tools, claimed no Envoy role and sent no message; the only listener writes were the DELETEs the tests are about and one cleanup DELETE per run. The rows carry an empty title, as in round 1 (a headless pane generates no session name and omp has no flag to set one); the scratch directory identifies them. GET /v1/sessions filtered to those directories was empty after the runs.
